 "rationale": "A PMOS input pair cannot take a 0.6 V common mode at 1.62 V and ss/-40, so vref and fb are scaled to about 0.3 V. The symmetrical OTA swings the gate rail-to-rail. Its gain of about 150 times beta 0.25 gives roughly 2 mV/mA. Miller Cc sets the UGB at 2.5x below p2 = gm_pass,min/CL. A 60 uA bleeder raises p2. Iq is about 115 uA plus the load."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in":   (14.0, 8.0, 18.0),     # input pair gm/Id (weak inversion -> low VSG)
    "L_in":      (0.5, 0.25, 1.0),
    "It":        (10e-6, 5e-6, 20e-6),  # OTA tail current
    "Lm":        (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),       # L of OTA mirrors/output devices (gain)
    "gmid_pass": (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),     # pass device gm/Id at ILOAD_MAX (tt)
    "L_pass":    (0.15, 0.15, 0.35),
    "Ibleed":    (60e-6, 20e-6, 80e-6), # min pass current -> pushes p2 up at light load
    "Idiv":      (5e-6, 2e-6, 20e-6),   # output divider current
    "kdiv":      (0.5, 0.3, 0.7),       # input CM = kdiv*vref
    "pm_ratio":  (2.5, 1.5, 6.0),       # p2(min load) / UGB
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vref = spec["vref"]; iref = spec["iref"]; vt = spec["vout_target"]
    cl = spec["cl"]; imin = spec["iload_min"]; imax = spec["iload_max"]
    k = p["kdiv"]; vcm = vref * k; beta = vcm / vt
    It = p["It"]; B = 2.0; Iout = B * It / 2.0
    Lm = p["Lm"]; Ib = p["Ibleed"]; Idv = p["Idiv"]

    # ---------------- bias (all mirrors: L=1, gm/Id=10, same vds for exact W ratios)
    mnb  = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, iref, vds=0.7)
    mnbp = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, It,   vds=0.7)
    mbl  = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, Ib,   vds=0.7)
    mpd  = lut.size("p", 10, 1.0, It,   vds=0.4)
    mpt  = lut.size("p", 10, 1.0, It,   vds=0.4)

    # ---------------- symmetrical OTA
    m12 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], It / 2, vds=0.5)
    m34 = lut.size("n", 10, Lm, It / 2, vds=0.6)
    m56 = lut.size("n", 10, Lm, Iout,   vds=0.6)
    m78 = lut.size("p", 10, Lm, Iout,   vds=0.6)

    # ---------------- pass device: size at tt, then guarantee ss/-40/1.62 V drive
    Lp = p["L_pass"]
    lss = lut.at("ss", -40)
    s = 1.0
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_pass"], Lp, 5.5e-3, vds=0.5)
    for _ in range(12):
        mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_pass"], Lp, 5.5e-3 * s, vds=0.5)
        if mp.W > 4800:
            break
        d = lss.op("p", mp.W, Lp, 1.62 - 0.35, 0.42)
        if d["Id"] >= 6.0e-3:
            break
        s *= 1.25
    mfing = int(min(200, max(1, math.ceil(mp.W / 25.0))))

    # ---------------- compensation
    ipass_min = imin + Idv + Ib
    gm_pass_min = min(16.0, 14.0) * ipass_min * 0.85          # weak inversion, hot-corner derate
    cg = mp.cgg
    p2 = gm_pass_min / (2 * PI * (cl + cg))
    fu = p2 / p["pm_ratio"]
    gm_ea = B * m12.gm
    Cc = beta * gm_ea / (2 * PI * fu)
    Cc = min(max(Cc, 5e-12), 500e-12)
    fu = beta * gm_ea / (2 * PI * Cc)

    # ---------------- dividers
    Rtot = vt / Idv
    Rbot = Rtot * beta; Rtop = Rtot - Rbot
    Rr = 600e3
    Rrbot = Rr * k; Rrtop = Rr - Rrbot

    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    n.dev("MNB",  "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mnb)
    n.dev("MNBP", "pb",    "ibias", "vss", "vss", mnbp)
    n.dev("MBL",  "vout",  "ibias", "vss", "vss", mbl)
    n.dev("MPD",  "pb",    "pb",    "vin", "vin", mpd)
    n.dev("MPT",  "tail",  "pb",    "vin", "vin", mpt)
    n.dev("M1",   "d1",    "vrd",   "tail", "tail", m12)   # vref side -> pull-up path
    n.dev("M2",   "d2",    "fb",    "tail", "tail", m12)   # fb side   -> pull-down path
    n.dev("M3",   "d1",    "d1",    "vss", "vss", m34)
    n.dev("M4",   "d2",    "d2",    "vss", "vss", m34)
    n.dev("M5",   "pg",    "d1",    "vss", "vss", m56)
    n.dev("M6",   "gate",  "d2",    "vss", "vss", m56)
    n.dev("M7",   "pg",    "pg",    "vin", "vin", m78)
    n.dev("M8",   "gate",  "pg",    "vin", "vin", m78)
    n.dev("MP",   "vout",  "gate",  "vin", "vin", mp, m=mfing)
    n.C("CC", "gate", "vout", Cc)
    n.R("RF1", "vout", "fb", Rtop)
    n.R("RF2", "fb", "vss", Rbot)
    n.R("RR1", "vref", "vrd", Rrtop)
    n.R("RR2", "vrd", "vss", Rrbot)

    # ---------------- predictions
    A = gm_ea / (m56.gds + m78.gds)
    T = A * beta
    dvg = 0.30                                   # gate swing between min and max load
    load_reg = dvg / T / (imax - imin)
    vout_err = 0.5 / T / vt * 100 + 0.3
    iq = iref + It + It + B * It + Idv + Ib
    tau = 1.0 / (2 * PI * fu * 0.8)
    ripple = 0.3 * math.exp(-7e-6 / tau)
    vsg_in_ss = lss.size("p", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], It / 2, vds=0.5).vgs
    headroom_tail = 1.62 - (vcm + vsg_in_ss)
    return n, {"vout_err_pct": vout_err, "load_reg": load_reg, "iq": iq,
               "ripple_settled": ripple, "loop_gain_db": db(T),
               "ugb_hz": fu, "p2_min_hz": p2, "Cc": Cc, "W_pass": mp.W,
               "tail_headroom_ss_m40": headroom_tail}
```
